summary: Examples of path_join with tuples and lists, including the case where an absolute later component replaces earlier ones.
questions: What happens if a path_join component starts with a slash?

answer_card.title: path_join examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
{{ ('/etc', path, 'subdir', file) | path_join }}
# path='foo/bar', file='baz.txt' -> '/etc/foo/bar/subdir/baz.txt'

trustme: "{{ ['/etc', 'apt', 'trusted.d', 'mykey.gpg'] | path_join }}"  # /etc/apt/trusted.d/mykey.gpg

# absolute component resets the path
backup_path: "{{ ('/etc', backup_dir, backup_file) | path_join }}"
# backup_dir='/tmp', backup_file='/sample/baz.txt' -> '/sample/baz.txt'
```
